### Prerequisites
Silk-caffe needs autogenerated caffe.pb.h file to successfully compile. This
file is autogenerated when caffe src is compiled. Since we are not compiling
caffe source and using prebuilt library instead, we would need to manually compile
this file.

##### Compile aprotoc, cross-compile host protoc executable
```
mmm external/protobuf
```

##### Compile caffe.pb.h
From the root of your build run the following command
```
out/host/darwin-x86/bin/aprotoc --proto_path=external/caffe/src/caffe/proto --cpp_out=external/caffe/src/caffe/proto external/caffe/src/caffe/proto/caffe.proto
```

### Compile libcaffe

```
git clone git@github.com:sh1r0/caffe-android-lib.git
cd caffe-android-lib
USE_OPENBLAS=1 ANDROID_ABI="armeabi-v7a-hard-softfp with NEON" ./scripts/build_caffe.sh <NDK Location>
```
